crossRefs.note: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.” So…
Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go…
The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.”…
A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said…
But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today…
Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”
The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from Yahweh’s mouth.
“The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder…
But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said…
His servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb.…
In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Megiddo”.

people.name: Josiah
people.line: King of Judah known for his religious reforms

people.name: Megiddo
people.line: A strategic city in the Jezreel Valley

people.name: Neco
people.line: Egyptian Pharaoh during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim.

translations.web: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
translations.bsb: Josiah, however, did not turn away from him; instead, in order to engage him in battle, he disguised himself. He did not listen to Neco’s words from the mouth of God, but went to fight him on the Plain of Megiddo.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
translations.asv: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
